title: How to Start an LLC in Arizona: Step-by-Step Guide
summary: Learn how to start an LLC in Arizona, including naming, statutory agent, filing, publication, tax, and business-license requirements.
body_markdown: The articles generally require the entity name, principal address, statutory-agent information, whether the LLC is member-managed or manager-managed, organizer information, and the applicable member or manager details. For a manager-managed LLC, review the ACC’s instructions about listing members who meet the applicable ownership threshold.
